description.content:
The Fields endpoint returns a list of all fields available for specific data export jobs.
For `campaign` and `creative` export jobs, the query parameter `adReportType` is required.

query.description: (Required) Specifies the entity for which to retrieve available export fields.
Specifies the adReportType for which to retrieve available export fields.
